chapters.label: The goal, live
chapters.text: Wembley, the Euro 2020 final. England against Italy, second minute. Luke Shaw passes to Harry Kane. Kane sweeps it wide to Trippier. Cross... Shaw volleys! One-nil!

chapters.label: Watch Kane
chapters.text: Watch Kane again. He's a striker, but he loves to drop back and get the ball. He looks up, spots Trippier's run, and plays the perfect pass.

chapters.label: Behind the goal
chapters.text: From behind the goal: Trippier crosses, and Shaw smashes it in. His first goal for England!

chapters.label: Your turn
chapters.text: Your turn! Strikers, don't just wait up front. Drop back, get the ball, look up, and pass to your runners!
